result.title: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
result.summary: Sparsity and quantization reduce the cost of attention by skipping interactions and lowering the precision of those retained. However, useful interactions differ in their precision requirements: some tolerate low-precision scores while remaining sensitive to removal. We therefore introduce TriAttention, which assigns query-key (QK) tiles to skipping, 4-bit, or 8-bit computation, using 4-bit to retain quantization-tolerant interactions at lower cost. To represent compactly, we encode each head's computation regions with two diagonal-distance boundaries, keeping policy storage independent of context length. Offline calibration then evaluates candidate boundary pairs using normalized projected-output errors and complete-tile execution costs. Using these measurements, a model-wide allocator selects each head's boundaries to minimize calibration error under a shared computation budget. During prefill, the selected boundaries generate precision-grouped traversals for a fused kernel that skips omitted tiles and combines contributions from both QK precisions into one normalized attention output. The quantized keys and values prepared during prefill are then reused in a compressed key-value (KV) cache for decoding, reducing repeated reads of prompt data. Experiments show that TriAttention achieves end-to-end generation speedups of up to 7.88x over the Torch attention and 2.65x over the BF16 baseline. Meanwhile, TriAttention maintains quality comparable to the original models on general-purpose and long-context tasks. These results show how a compact retention-and-precision policy translates local sensitivities into attention computation and repeated KV-cache access. The implementation is https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TriAttention.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TriAttention，按 query-key tile 的敏感度将其分配到跳过、4-bit 或 8-bit 计算，用两个对角距离边界紧凑表示每个 head 的计算区域，并通过离线校准与全局预算分配选择边界，配合融合 kernel 与压缩 KV cache 加速长上下文推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文观察到「某些交互可容忍低精度但不容忍被移除」，这种按敏感度区分的注意力交互保留与精度分配，可供核查其是否有助于刻画 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 KV 缓存对 latent 内容保真度的影响。
